title: DestructiveFindings
description: Sidecar artifact for destructive / fuzz / chaos campaigns. Lives next to the standard benchmark-result.json. Captures crash/OOM/hang counts, post-attack liveness probe, RSS/native-heap deltas, and a degradation classification. Destructive findings are EXPLORATORY by construction: results are never comparison_eligible and must not enter the comparative aggregation pipeline.

run_id.description: Matches the run_id of the paired BenchmarkResult artifact.

scenario.description: Scenario id from docs/scenario-catalog.md (e.g. fuzz-http1-parser, destructive-slowloris-h1).

duration_seconds.description: Wall-clock duration of the attack/fuzz window (excluding warmup/cooldown).

claim_scope.description: Destructive findings are never comparison_eligible. Locked to exploratory.

comparison_axis.description: Destructive runs do not enter cross-tier or within-tier comparison axes.

iterations_total.description: Total fuzz iterations / attack requests dispatched.

crash_count.description: Unexpected throwables from the SUT (excluding whitelisted parse exceptions). Each is a finding.

oom_count.description: Iterations where the SUT threw OutOfMemoryError or the JVM exited with OOM-killed.

hang_count.description: Iterations that exceeded the per-iteration timeout without returning.

unique_crash_signatures.description: Distinct stack-trace top-frames among recorded crashes.

mean_time_to_crash_us.description: Mean microseconds from attack start to first observed crash; null if no crashes.

leak_count_delta.description: (MemoryStats.leakCount after) - (MemoryStats.leakCount before). Negative if pool released more than expected.

liveness_probe.description: Post-attack clean-traffic liveness probe. Mandatory for slowloris/radamsa/arena-lifecycle campaigns.

asserted_alive.description: true iff status_code == expected_status AND duration_ms <= expected_max_response_ms.

resource_delta.description: Process resource snapshot before vs after attack window. Optional for jazzer-parser (in-process JMH-like) campaigns.

jfr_recording_path.description: Path to the JFR recording covering the attack window. NEVER published in public mode.

degradation_class.description: Observed failure/degradation classification. 'stable' = target absorbed attack and liveness probe passed within tolerance.

tool_versions.description: Pinned versions of attack tooling (jazzer, radamsa, slowloris-driver) and kernel artifact under test.

seeds.description: Reproducibility seeds. Without these the campaign is not reproducible and the artifact is descriptive-only.

tolerance.description: Scenario-declared tolerance thresholds that produced the degradation_class.

publication_mode.description: Destructive findings sidecars are locked to internal-only publication. Crash inputs and raw attack corpora may contain attacker-supplied bytes and are blocked in public/redacted modes by publish-report.sh.
